conflicts.name: Iran‑Israel/US War / Hormuz
conflicts.description: Full-scale military confrontation between Iran and Israel/US, with closure of the Strait of Hormuz, missile exchanges, and naval skirmishes. Oil price spikes and global supply chain disruption.

conflicts.name: Direct US‑Iran Conflict
conflicts.description: Direct military exchanges between US forces and Iran, including airstrikes and naval engagements. Escalation risk remains high.

conflicts.name: Iran 'Resistance Security Belt'
conflicts.description: Coordinated choke‑point doctrine from Hormuz to Bab el‑Mandeb, targeting US and allied shipping. Involves proxy forces across the region.

conflicts.name: Bab el‑Mandeb Blockade
conflicts.description: Houthi blockade of the Bab el‑Mandeb strait, targeting Israeli and US shipping. Disrupts global trade and threatens oil supply.

conflicts.name: Great Power Conflict / US‑Iran Entanglement
conflicts.description: Escalation involving US, Iran, Russia, and China across multiple theaters. Risk of broader war if miscalculation occurs.

conflicts.name: Armenia‑Azerbaijan
conflicts.description: Renewed armed conflict over Nagorno‑Karabakh, with border clashes and artillery exchanges. Risk of wider regional war.

conflicts.name: Baltic Grey‑Zone
conflicts.description: Russian hybrid warfare in the Baltic region, including GPS jamming, cyber attacks, and intimidation of NATO allies.

conflicts.name: Taiwan Strait Incident Risk
conflicts.description: Increased Chinese military activity and US naval patrols in the Taiwan Strait. Risk of miscalculation or accidental clash.

conflicts.name: South China Sea Militarisation
conflicts.description: China's expansion of artificial islands and military presence in the South China Sea, increasing tensions with Philippines, Vietnam, and the US.

conflicts.name: Zaporizhzhia NPP
conflicts.description: Ongoing shelling and military activity around Europe's largest nuclear plant. Risk of radiation leak or meltdown.

conflicts.name: NATO Article 4 (Romania)
conflicts.description: Romania considers activating NATO Article 4 following Russian drone incursions. Potential to bring NATO into direct consultation.

conflicts.name: Ukraine‑Russia Spillover
conflicts.description: The war in Ukraine extends beyond its borders, affecting neighbouring NATO states through missile strikes, drone incursions, or refugee surges.

conflicts.name: Iraq Instability
conflicts.description: Resurgence of ISIS, Shia militias, and political deadlock in Iraq. Threatens oil infrastructure and regional security.

conflicts.name: Underwater Infrastructure Sabotage
conflicts.description: Suspected Russian attacks on undersea cables, gas pipelines, and internet cables, disrupting global communications and energy supplies.

conflicts.name: Narva Border Crisis
conflicts.description: Estonia‑Russia border tensions, with Russian military exercises near Narva. Risk of provocation.

conflicts.name: Mediterranean Migration
conflicts.description: Increased irregular migration flows from North Africa and Middle East, straining EU border states and creating humanitarian crises.

conflicts.name: Cartel Violence Mexico
conflicts.description: Intensified fighting between drug cartels, leading to mass casualties, displacement, and potential spillover into the US.

conflicts.name: North Korea Ballistic
conflicts.description: North Korea tests ICBMs capable of reaching the US, raising tensions and risking military response.

conflicts.name: Moldova Transnistria escalation
conflicts.description: Russia‑backed separatists in Transnistria may provoke a crisis, threatening Moldova's security and potentially drawing in NATO and Russia.

conflicts.name: Russian sabotage in Germany/Poland
conflicts.description: Suspected Russian sabotage operations targeting infrastructure in Germany and Poland, including railways and communications.

conflicts.name: Finland‑Russia border closure
conflicts.description: Finland closes its border with Russia following hybrid attacks and migrant influx. Tensions remain high.

conflicts.name: Poland‑Belarus migrant weaponisation
conflicts.description: Belarus funnels migrants to the Polish border, creating a humanitarian and security crisis. Poland reinforces border.

conflicts.name: Ukraine frontline collapse
conflicts.description: Russian forces break through Ukrainian defenses near Avdiivka, threatening a wider frontline collapse.

conflicts.name: Black Sea grain corridor closure
conflicts.description: Russia threatens to withdraw from the Black Sea grain initiative, risking global food prices and famine.

conflicts.name: Russian LNG terminal sabotage
conflicts.description: Sabotage of Russian LNG terminals in the Baltic, disrupting European energy supplies and raising prices.

conflicts.name: Nord Stream 2 reactivation
conflicts.description: Germany considers reactivating Nord Stream 2 to ease energy crisis, raising geopolitical tensions with the US and Ukraine.

conflicts.name: Transnistria depot explosion
conflicts.description: Explosions at a military depot in Transnistria raise fears of a wider conflict involving Moldova and Ukraine.

conflicts.name: Georgia Abkhazia freeze‑thaw
conflicts.description: Russia escalates tensions in Abkhazia, threatening Georgian sovereignty and regional stability.

conflicts.name: Armenia‑Azerbaijan peace collapse
conflicts.description: Peace talks between Armenia and Azerbaijan collapse, with renewed border clashes and risk of full‑scale war.

conflicts.name: Iranian drones to Russia
conflicts.description: Iran continues to supply drones to Russia, deepening the military partnership and escalating the Ukraine war.

conflicts.name: Khmelnytskyi NPP shelling
conflicts.description: Shelling near the Khmelnytskyi Nuclear Power Plant raises fears of a nuclear incident similar to Zaporizhzhia.

conflicts.name: Radiological release (ZNPP)
conflicts.description: Radiological release from Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant due to ongoing shelling. Risk of catastrophic regional fallout.

conflicts.name: Russian internal coup
conflicts.description: Speculation of a coup attempt within the Russian leadership, triggered by war fatigue and economic strain.

conflicts.name: Wagner resurgence in Africa
conflicts.description: Wagner Group activities increase in Africa, threatening stability in Mali, Burkina Faso, and the Central African Republic.

conflicts.name: Russian Arctic militarisation
conflicts.description: Russia expands military presence in the Arctic, threatening NATO interests and opening a new front.

conflicts.name: NATO Article 5 deliberation
conflicts.description: NATO members deliberate invoking Article 5 following a major incident with Russia. Risk of collective defence activation.

conflicts.name: US troop deployment to Romania
conflicts.description: US deploys additional troops to Romania in response to Russian aggression. Raises NATO‑Russia tensions.

conflicts.name: Turkish Straits closure
conflicts.description: Turkey threatens to close the Bosphorus and Dardanelles to Russian shipping, escalating tensions and impacting global trade.

conflicts.name: Arctic resource wars
conflicts.description: Competition for Arctic oil, gas, and shipping routes intensifies between Russia, the US, China, and NATO nations.

conflicts.name: Greenland as geopolitical flashpoint
conflicts.description: US and China compete for influence in Greenland, with rare earth mining and military positioning.

conflicts.name: Weaponisation of low Earth orbit
conflicts.description: US, China, and Russia test anti‑satellite weapons and deploy space‑based capabilities. Risk of orbital conflict.

conflicts.name: West Bank violent escalation
conflicts.description: Surging violence in the West Bank and East Jerusalem, with clashes between Israeli forces and Palestinian militants.

conflicts.name: Blue Nile / GERD water war
conflicts.description: Ethiopia's Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD) continues to cause tensions with Egypt and Sudan over Nile water rights.

conflicts.name: Central Asia Energy Export Dependency
conflicts.description: Central Asian nations' energy exports are increasingly vulnerable to Russian and Chinese influence, threatening global supplies.

conflicts.name: Russia brokering role
conflicts.description: Russia positions itself as a broker in regional conflicts, attempting to regain diplomatic influence.

conflicts.name: Caucasus frozen conflict
conflicts.description: Frozen conflicts in the Caucasus (Abkhazia, South Ossetia, Nagorno‑Karabakh) threaten to re‑ignite.

conflicts.name: Georgia destabilisation
conflicts.description: Russia intensifies efforts to destabilise Georgia, using disinformation, cyber attacks, and proxy forces.

conflicts.name: Pacific strategic competition
conflicts.description: US‑China competition in the Pacific intensifies, with military build‑up in Guam, Philippines, and Solomon Islands.

conflicts.name: Great‑Power Competition → Aid Diversion
conflicts.description: Great‑power competition diverts humanitarian aid to political ends, exacerbating suffering in conflict zones.

conflicts.name: Red Sea Shipping Chokepoint
conflicts.description: Houthi attacks on shipping in the Red Sea threaten global trade and energy security.

conflicts.name: Gaza Structural Atrocity
conflicts.description: Ongoing conflict in Gaza, with civilian casualties, infrastructure destruction, and humanitarian crisis.

conflicts.name: Mediterranean Migration
conflicts.description: Surge in migrant crossings from Libya and Turkey, straining EU border states and creating humanitarian crises.

conflicts.name: Sahel instability
conflicts.description: Wagner Group and local militants expand operations in the Sahel, threatening security and food supplies.
